title: Cold rebuild: Does the chain validate?
summary: Rebuild Does the chain validate? from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **Does the chain validate?** in *Trust stores and what servers send*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.prompt: `X509Chain` builds chains in .NET. Here the trust store is replaced by our own root, and `ExtraStore` plays the role of "certificates the server sent". What does it print?
code: var root = DojoCert("CN=Dojo Root", null, true);
var inter = DojoCert("CN=Dojo Issuing CA", root, true);
Console.WriteLine(chain.Build(leaf));          // server sent only the leaf
chain.ChainPolicy.ExtraStore.Add(inter);        // server sent the intermediate too
static X509Certificate2 DojoCert(string subject, X509Certificate2? issuer, bool isCa, string? dns = null, string? eku = null, int nbYear = 2030, int naYear = 2035)
var req = new CertificateRequest(subject, key, HashAlgorithmName.SHA256);
req.CertificateExtensions.Add(new X509KeyUsageExtension(isCa ? X509KeyUsageFlags.KeyCertSign | X509KeyUsageFlags.CrlSign : X509KeyUsageFlags.DigitalSignature, true));
if (dns != null) { var b = new SubjectAlternativeNameBuilder(); foreach (var d in dns.Split(',')) b.AddDnsName(d); req.CertificateExtensions.Add(b.Build()); }
if (eku != null) req.CertificateExtensions.Add(new X509EnhancedKeyUsageExtension(new OidCollection { new Oid(eku) }, false));
using var pub = req.Create(issuer, nb, na, serial);
steps.explain: Without the intermediate there is no path from the leaf to the root. With it, the chain is leaf, intermediate, root: three elements.

steps.title: Rebuild Does the chain validate? cold
prompt: Write `bool Validates(X509Certificate2 leaf, List<X509Certificate2> sent, X509Certificate2 root)` that returns whether
`leaf` chains up to `root`, using **only** `root` as the trust anchor and the `sent` certificates as extra candidates.
Set up an `X509Chain` like the previous step:
- `VerificationTime = new DateTime(2031, 6, 1, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc)` (the test certificates are valid 2030 to 2035)
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty and the tests are the ones you passed in the lesson.
Type the shape yourself, then fill it in:
bool Validates(X509Certificate2 leaf, List<X509Certificate2> sent, X509Certificate2 root)
